answer: proof of unique tax agent registration with revenue authority attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a registration the revenue authority renews against filing history and conduct, the ripple of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the whisper is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the grove is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
